name: Mortgage stress test (minimum qualifying rate) and debt-service guidelines
description: Borrowers must qualify at the greater of 5.25% or the contract rate plus 2 percentage points, for both insured and uninsured mortgages from federally regulated lenders. Straight switches of uninsured mortgages at renewal are exempt.
